title: 2011 AMC 10A Problem 1
statement: A cell phone plan costs \(\$20\) each month, plus \(5\)¢ per text message sent, plus \(10\)¢ for each minute used over \(30\) hours. In January Michelle sent \(100\) text messages and talked for \(30.5\) hours. How much did she have to pay?

solutions.text:
Michelle has to pay \(\$20\) for the monthly fee. Her text messages cost \[100\cdot 5=500\] cents, or \(\$5.\) Finally she talked for \(0.5\) hours, \(30\) minutes, over \(30\) hours.

This means her extra charge is \[30\cdot10=300\] cents, or \(\$3.\)

Her total cost is \[ \$20 + \$5 + \$3 = \$28. \]

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Convert the texting charge and excess-call charge into dollars
Only the extra half hour is billed by the minute
